label: early original steps of e-initial sequences + last copy step of length-3 sequences
explanation: Mixed unit with two main components. (1) Original phase, steps 2-3 of sequences whose first token is e (y is a weaker version); it never fires at t=0 or 1, and in the original phase it essentially never fires past t=4. (2) Final copy step of length-3 sequences (recall_idx 2), where precision is about 0.5 and the strongest activations occur, especially when the output is e. It also fires weakly and diffusely during the copy phase when outputting e/y and at recall_idx 2-3 in short sequences; I could not capture this part cleanly. It almost never fires on the delimiter step. Dev F1 is 0.42 and mass recall 0.54.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: L=3 & recall_idx=2 (+5.72), out_tok=e (+5.69), t=3 (+5.22), t=4 (+4.14), next_out=e (+3.62), phase=2 & out_tok=n (+3.48). Lower it: in_count=0 (-8.46), next_out=p (-3.88), out_tok=p (-3.53), next_out=i (-3.51).
